gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: All things change. It is with a heavy heart that I tell you that the Art Experience, Inc will be dissolving as a non-profit. We have touched many lives over the 16 years we have served the community and we are grateful for the opportunity. Now new things need to happen. Our Art therapy groups will not be meeting any more, due to my relocation to the northeast to be with family.
